query: What is the most recent NIFC National Fire News year-to-date acres burned figure for 2026, latest available as of late June 2026? Report the exact YTD acres and date.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the key takeaway:

**The exact "late June 2026" NIFC year-to-date figure is not retrievable** — NIFC overwrites its daily reports at the same URLs, and no June 2026 archive snapshot exists. As accessed on 2026-07-15, the NIFC pages show the **July 13/14, 2026** data.

**Best available figures:**
- **Closest to late June 2026:** ~**2.07 million acres** from **27,446 wildfires** (Newsweek citing NIFC, ~July 2–3, 2026) — the nearest retrievable point after the late-June window. A true June 29 value would be slightly lower (~2.0 million acres).
- **Current live NIFC figure:** **3,616,860 acres** from **39,354 wildfires** (National YTD Report dated July 13, 2026, executed July 14, 2026), at 135% of the ten-year average.

The apparent "June 29, 2026" reference on the NIFC National Fire News page is only a label on the Preparedness Level graphic — its actual statistics reflect current (July 14) numbers, not a preserved June 29 report.

key_facts: NIFC's Statistics page, IMSR, and National YTD-by-State report are live documents overwritten daily; no archived late-June 2026 snapshot is retrievable (no Wayback capture for June 2026).
Closest-to-late-June retrievable figure: Newsweek (published July 3, 2026) cited NIFC year-to-date at ~2.07 million acres from 27,446 wildfires (~July 2-3, 2026 data).
Current live NIFC figure (report date July 13, 2026; executed July 14, 2026): year-to-date acres burned = 3,616,860 acres.
Current live NIFC year-to-date wildfires = 39,354 (IMSR 'by Protection' table shows 39,090 fires / 3,586,194 acres due to reporting lag).
As of the July 13, 2026 report: 46 uncontained large fires, 680,977 acres burned on large fires, National Preparedness Level 4.
2026 acres YTD were running at 135% of the 2016-2025 ten-year average (avg 2,666,032 acres); fires at 129% of average (avg 30,241).

The NIFC National Fire News page shows an 'as of June 29, 2026' label only on its Preparedness Level graphic; the fire statistics themselves reflect current (July 14, 2026) numbers, not a preserved June 29 report.
